The Highlord of the Silver Hand, or simply the Highlord, is a nameless paladin and the current leader of the Order of the Silver Hand. Following the death of Tirion Fordring on the Broken Shore, a champion of the Light succeeded him as the wielder of the Ashbringer, united all the paladin orders under their command, and led the fight against the Burning Legion during their third invasion of Azeroth. The Highlord is supported in their duties by a war council, including veteran paladins and Lord Maxwell Tyrosus, the "Hand of the Highlord", who serves as their eyes and blade where they cannot.

An honorable kill (abbreviated HK) is a kill which grants :honor in the honor system. Honorable Kills are gained by killing members of the opposite faction. If you kill an opposing player that is within 5 levels of you, you gain honor. The amount of honor you gain is based on your level and your target's level. You do not need to deliver the killing blow, nor do you even need to be in the same party. All members of a party will receive honor and an honorable kill if they are in proximity to the kill. In Battlegrounds, honor is gained by killing the other team and completing objectives. Honorable Kills are also required for several PvP achievements.
